validationNotes.emptyMarkup: Only zero-content, image-free anchors from the original secondary-weapon fixture are excluded from visible-command hit tests. No nonempty text or image control is excluded.
validationNotes.resultCallback: In disposable DOM only, QA variables are prepended to the original result thumb EXEC command. The original gt command is preserved and clicked. The exit location in the disposable QSP is a completion sentinel; product callback markup and game state are unchanged.
validationNotes.configEncoding: Raw UTF-16LE with FF FE BOM; no text recoding.
